metadata.title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Gazetteer - Interim Verified Seed
metadata.status: INCOMPLETE INTERIM DATASET - NOT A COMPLETE KPK VILLAGE LIST
metadata.pbs_baseline_note: 9,821 is the province-wide 2023 census count. The full 9,821 named PBS rows are NOT present in this interim JSON because the PDF bytes could not be transferred into this session for extraction.
metadata.critical_warning: Do not deploy this as a complete KPK locality list. It contains child locality labels only for Lower Dir and Upper Dir, plus Kalam Mouza names. Other districts are coverage gaps, not empty districts.
metadata.source_hierarchy: PBS Table 31 named rural locality baseline; SLR detailed Mouza/child locality register; LGKP/ECP council lists as a separate administrative layer.
